about: Headless bot playtests of Lure v2 (game/sim.js). Bots are skill proxies, not taste proxies. 'random' = no-skill floor; 'evader' = crude competent player (flee + swirl, dodges telegraphs). Averages over 10 runs per cell. kps = lured kills/s, c3 = 3+ chains per minute, firstKill/noKill in seconds, nm = near-misses per minute, deaths = what landed the final hit.
notes: Before the in-path assist-mine fix, 1 of 12 evader runs stalled on the final wave for 400s (lone enemy, nothing to lure it into). After the fix: 0 of 32.
The evader bot uses dash only as a panic button, so dash vs no-dash bot results say nothing about how dash feels to a human.
For reference, Mikael in v1 reached wave 7 at ~100s, with 0.28-0.59 kills/s.
